description: Simulate degraded network conditions with latency, jitter, packet loss, and bandwidth limits to test applications.
notes: Requires Administrator rights for traffic interception and loads the bundled WinDivert driver. Close the app before updating or uninstalling; a loaded driver can keep its version directory locked. The --cleanup-driver recovery command can also stop WinDivert 1.4/1.1 services used by other applications.
